key_insight: An LLM-orchestrated pipeline can check stroke-care guideline adherence directly from unstructured clinical texts, without needing computer-interpretable guidelines.
clinical_relevance: This could make conformance checking more practical for hospitals that have discharge letters and narrative guidelines but lack formal guideline models.
method: LLMs extracted patient traces from discharge letters.
LLMs identified normative rules from textual clinical guidelines.
Rules were translated into executable scripts to calculate a Trace Conformance Indicator.
evidence_signal: In the stroke unit at Alessandria Hospital, hundreds of patient traces were compared against 50 guideline-derived rules, and over 86% of available traces were conformant.
watch_item: Performance depends on LLM extraction and rule translation quality, so errors or bias in unstructured text handling could affect conformance results.
paper_title: LLM-Orchestrated Conformance Checking in Stroke Care Without Computer-Interpretable Guidelines
